name: together-dedicated
description: Deploy a model Together AI already serves onto a dedicated endpoint (v2): `machine acquire --provider together` drives the service's own CLI (`tg beta endpoints deploy`), and what comes back is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on https://api-inference.together.ai/v1 rather than a host. The model is yours to declare: replace the SET-ME placeholder with a model `tg beta models public --product dedicated` lists. The hardware is the certified config the CLI picks when the model has exactly one; name it with "together.config" (a cr_ id from `tg beta models configs <model>`) otherwise. No requires_ports, no requires_disk, no engine arguments: the engine is the platform's, and a profile declaring any of these is refused by name. The lease is the endpoint's name; the pod verbs (apply, logs, exec, cp, port-forward) do not apply to such a machine and say so. Needs TOGETHER_API_KEY and TOGETHER_PROJECT_ID.
